purpose: Selected precomputed plotting demonstration; not an end-to-end calculation benchmark.
selection: Six largest complete blocks whose pairs occur in the supplied BLAST, Ks and both annotations; original order retained.
ks_preparation: Select block pairs and remove exactly duplicated source records; rates are unchanged.
blast_selection: Keep the selected blocks' query genes and annotated subject genes; retain source record order and numeric values.
lens_preparation: Regenerate two-column counts from annotation column 7; omit Ases chromosome 20, which has no annotation records in this source collection.
